name: K1W1 App Build

on:
  # Triggered by Supabase Edge Function via repository_dispatch
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [trigger-eas-build]

  # Manual trigger from GitHub UI (optional)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      job_id:
        description: "Optional Job ID from K1W1 App (for status tracking)"
        required: false
        type: string
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile (development|preview|production)"
        required: false
        default: "preview"
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    name: EAS Build (Android, WAIT)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    env:
      SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
      SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
      # repo_dispatch sends github.event.client_payload.job_id
      # workflow_dispatch sends inputs.job_id
      JOB_ID: ${{ github.event.client_payload.job_id || inputs.job_id || '' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine build profile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          PROFILE="${{ github.event.client_payload.build_profile }}"
          if [ -z "${PROFILE}" ]; then
            PROFILE="${{ github.event.client_payload.buildProfile }}"
          fi
          if [ -z "${PROFILE}" ]; then
            PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          fi
          if [ -z "${PROFILE}" ]; then
            PROFILE="preview"
          fi

          if [[ ! "${PROFILE}" =~ ^(development|preview|production)$ ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Invalid PROFILE='${PROFILE}', defaulting to preview"
            PROFILE="preview"
          fi

          echo "PROFILE=${PROFILE}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          echo "✅ Using build profile: ${PROFILE}"

      - name: Validate Job ID
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${JOB_ID}" ]; then
            echo "has_job_id=false" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
            echo "⚠️ No JOB_ID provided -> Supabase status updates will be skipped."
          else
            echo "has_job_id=true" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
            echo "✅ JOB_ID: ${JOB_ID}"
          fi

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Ensure EXPO_TOKEN exists
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ EXPO_TOKEN secret is set"

      - name: Setup Expo & EAS
        uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          expo-version: latest
          eas-version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
          packager: npm
          expo-cache: true
          eas-cache: true

      - name: Verify EAS authentication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eas --version
          eas whoami

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Update Build Status - Building
        if: env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}" \
            -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Prefer: return=minimal" \
            -d "{\"status\":\"building\",\"build_profile\":\"${PROFILE}\",\"github_run_id\":\"${{ github.run_id }}\",\"started_at\":\"${TS}\"}" \
            || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status"

      - name: Run EAS Build (WAIT)
        id: eas
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "🚀 Starting EAS build (android, profile=${PROFILE}) with --wait..."

          BUILD_OUTPUT="$(eas build \
            --platform android \
            --profile "${PROFILE}" \
            --non-interactive \
            --wait \
            2>&1)" || {
              CODE=$?
              echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"
              echo "::error::EAS build failed (exit ${CODE})"
              exit "${CODE}"
            }

          echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"

          BUILD_ID="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oP 'Build ID:\\s*\\K[a-fA-F0-9-]+' | head -n1 || true)"
          if [ -z "${BUILD_ID}" ]; then BUILD_ID="unknown"; fi
          echo "build_id=${BUILD_ID}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

          BUILD_URL="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oP 'https://expo\\.dev/accounts/[^/]+/projects/[^/]+/builds/[a-fA-F0-9-]+' | head -n1 || true)"
          echo "build_url=${BUILD_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Download Android Artifact (APK)
        if: steps.eas.outputs.build_id != 'unknown' && steps.eas.outputs.build_id != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build
          echo "📦 Downloading APK for build: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}"
          eas build:download \
            --id "${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}" \
            --output "build/k1w1-${PROFILE}.apk" || {
              echo "::warning::Failed to download APK"
              exit 0
            }
          ls -lah build || true

      - name: Upload Android Artifact
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: k1w1-android-${{ env.PROFILE }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/*.apk
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Update Build Status - Success
        if: success() && env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}" \
            -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Prefer: return=minimal" \
            -d "{\"status\":\"completed\",\"eas_build_id\":\"${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}\",\"build_url\":\"${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_url }}\",\"completed_at\":\"${TS}\"}" \
            || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status"

      - name: Update Build Status - Failed
        if: failure() && env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
          ERR="Build failed. Check GitHub Actions logs: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}" \
            -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Prefer: return=minimal" \
            -d "{\"status\":\"error\",\"github_run_id\":\"${{ github.run_id }}\",\"error_message\":\"${ERR}\",\"completed_at\":\"${TS}\"}" \
            || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status"

name: Release Build (WAIT)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: "Platform to build"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [android, ios, all]
        default: android
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [production, preview, development]
        default: production

jobs:
  build:
    name: Release Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Ensure EXPO_TOKEN exists
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ EXPO_TOKEN secret is set"

      - name: Setup Expo & EAS
        uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          expo-version: latest
          eas-version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
          packager: npm
          expo-cache: true
          eas-cache: true

      - name: Verify EAS authentication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eas --version
          eas whoami

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Run EAS build (WAIT)
        id: eas
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "🚀 Starting EAS build (platform=${{ inputs.platform }}, profile=${{ inputs.profile }}) with --wait..."

          BUILD_OUTPUT="$(eas build \
            --platform "${{ inputs.platform }}" \
            --profile "${{ inputs.profile }}" \
            --non-interactive \
            --wait \
            2>&1)" || {
              CODE=$?
              echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"
              echo "::error::EAS build failed (exit ${CODE})"
              exit "${CODE}"
            }

          echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"

          BUILD_ID="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oP 'Build ID:\\s*\\K[a-fA-F0-9-]+' | head -n1 || true)"
          if [ -z "${BUILD_ID}" ]; then BUILD_ID="unknown"; fi
          echo "build_id=${BUILD_ID}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "✅ Build ID: ${BUILD_ID}"

          BUILD_URL="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oP 'https://expo\\.dev/accounts/[^/]+/projects/[^/]+/builds/[a-fA-F0-9-]+' | head -n1 || true)"
          echo "build_url=${BUILD_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          if [ -n "${BUILD_URL}" ]; then echo "🔗 Build URL: ${BUILD_URL}"; fi

      - name: Download Android APK
        if: (inputs.platform == 'android' || inputs.platform == 'all') && steps.eas.outputs.build_id != 'unknown' && steps.eas.outputs.build_id != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build
          eas build:download \
            --id "${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}" \
            --output "build/k1w1-${{ inputs.profile }}.apk" || {
              echo "::warning::Failed to download APK"
              exit 0
            }
          ls -lah build || true

      - name: Upload Android Artifact
        if: inputs.platform == 'android' || inputs.platform == 'all'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: k1w1-android-${{ inputs.profile }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/*.apk
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" << 'EOF'
          ## Release Build

          - Platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}
          - Profile: ${{ inputs.profile }}
          - Build ID: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}
          - Build URL: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_url }}

          Artifacts (if any): https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          EOF
